name: lastlight
description: Source, validation, and production blueprint for the Roblox game Last Light.

scripts.check: node scripts/validate-plan.mjs && python3 scripts/validate_call_arity.py && python3 scripts/validate_mesh_assets.py && python3 scripts/validate_image_assets.py && python3 scripts/validate_audio_assets.py && python3 scripts/validate_monetization.py && python3 scripts/validate_schema_freeze.py && python3 scripts/validate_town_layout.py
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:luau && npm run build && npm run verify:build
